reasoning: Add a notification service: a DB migration and the Notification model, a dedicated Email-sending module, a WebSocket endpoint with integration, pytest tests and delivery via a Pull Request.

tasks.title: Git Sync: clone the repository
tasks.prompt: Clone or update (git pull) the repository https://github.com/your-org/your-web-app into the current working directory and prepare the working environment.

tasks.title: DB: migration and the Notification model
tasks.prompt: Create a database migration and the Notification model (id, user_id, type, payload, read, created_at). Use the project's existing ORM (SQLAlchemy/Prisma) and update DATABASE.md with a description of the new table.

tasks.title: Email: dedicated sending module
tasks.prompt: Create a dedicated email-sending module: a send_email(to, subject, body) function via an SMTP/API provider, configuration through environment variables, and simple email templates. Update ARCHITECTURE.md with a description of the module.

tasks.title: API: WebSocket endpoint and integration
tasks.prompt: Add a WebSocket endpoint /ws/notifications that delivers notifications to subscribed clients. Integrate it with the Notification model and the Email module: when a notification is created, simultaneously send a WebSocket message and an Email. Update API_SPEC.md with a description of the new endpoint.

tasks.title: Tests & Delivery
tasks.prompt: Write pytest tests for the Notification model, the Email module and the WebSocket endpoint. Run python -m py_compile over the changed files and pytest; fix the issues you find. Then commit the changes with a clear message, push the feature/notification-service branch and open a Pull Request into main with a description of the feature.
